en: having a meaning that is mysterious or not easily understood

syn.tran: 神秘的，含义模糊的；[动]隐藏的

sent.en: The governor was usually circumspect when dealing with the media.
sent.zh: 这位州长和媒体打交道时通常都很谨慎小心。

rem: circum (周围) + spect (看) → 向周围看 → 慎重的
en: thinking carefully about something before doing it, in order to avoid risk

rem: syn (共同) + opsis (看) → 写出大纲让大家一起看 → 大纲

words.z: 天气的；概要的；对观福音书的

pos.z: 沉思，冥想；反省；考虑；策划

sent.en: I try to meditate for half an hour every evening.
sent.zh: 我每天晚上尽量默想半小时。

rem: medi (中间) + tate (可看作taste， 品味) → 沉浸其中， 品味过去 → 沉思
en: to think seriously and deeply about something

words.z: 冥想的，沉思的；耽于默想的

sent.en: Even close friends were unaware of the tribulations she faced.
sent.zh: 即使是亲近的朋友也不了解她所面对的种种艰辛。

rem: tribul (给予) + ation → 上天给予的 (惩罚) → 苦难， 磨难
en: serious trouble or a serious problem

pos.z: 原型； 标准； 模范

phr.z: 样机试验；原型试验；实船实验

rem: proto (首先) + type (形状) → 最开始的形状 → 原型
en: the first form that a new design of a car, machine etc has, or a model of it used to test the design before it is produced

phr.z: 人口学特征；个人背景特征
n. 人口转变，人口过渡

sent.en: In the same demographic breakdown of people may have different characteristics of the consumer mentality.
sent.zh: 处于同一人口统计细分的人们，可能具有不同的消费心态特征。

sent.en: It is generally studied and mapped by an organization through lists and reportscontaining demographic information that may have an effect on the marketing of keyproducts or services.
sent.zh: 组织通常通过包含了可能对主要产品或服务的市场营销产生影响的人口统计信息的列表或包括来研究或划分它的。

rem: demo (人民) + graph (学科) + ic (的) → 人口统计学的

syn.tran: 人口统计学的；人口学的

words.z: [统计] 人口统计学家，人口学家

pos.z: 回忆， 想起， 记起

sent.en: All I recollect is a grey sky.
sent.zh: 我只记得一片灰色的天空。

rem: 和recall (v. 回想) 一起记
en: to be able to remember something

sent.en: She wore no makeup, and her face was dotted with acne.
sent.zh: 她没有化妆，脸上长满了粉刺。

en: a medical problem which causes a lot of red spots on your face and neck and mainly affects young people

sent.en: They became involved in an altercation.
sent.zh: 他们争辩了起来。

rem: 因如何改变 (alter) 而发生口角 (altercation)

sent.en: The judge cited a 1956 Supreme Court ruling in her decision.
sent.zh: 法官在她的判决中引用了1956年最高法院的一项裁决。

rem: cit (引用； 唤起) + e → 引用， 引证
en: to mention something as an example, especially one that supports, proves, or explains an idea or situation

words.z: 引用，引证；[法] 传票；褒扬

phr.z: 相识不深的人；不完整或肤浅的知识

sent.en: She was a casual acquaintance of my family in Vienna.
sent.zh: 她是我们家在维也纳的一个交情不深的朋友。

sent.en: He heard about the job through a mutual acquaintance (=  someone you and another person both know  ) .
sent.zh: 他是通过一个双方都认识的人知道有这份工作的。

rem: ac + quaint (知道) + ance → 知道的人 → 熟人
en: someone you know, but who is not a close friend

words.z: 熟识的；知晓的；有知识的
